say:1:1631822001:1.text: I let this guy, Hepler, turn me into other animals.
say:1:1631822001:1.source_cn: 我让一个叫赫普的把我变成了其他动物。
say:1:1631822001:1.male: I let this guy, Hepler, turn me into other animals.
say:1:1631822001:1.female: I let this guy, Hepler, turn me into other animals.

say:2:1631822002:1.text: Worst experience of my life. I begged him to change me back.
say:2:1631822002:1.source_cn: 简直就是十分恐怖的经历，吓得我赶紧求他把我变回来。
say:2:1631822002:1.male: Worst experience of my life. I begged him to change me back.
say:2:1631822002:1.female: Worst experience of my life. I begged him to change me back.

say:3:1631822003:1.text: And yeah... maybe I made too much noise earlier about wanting to try transfiguration.
say:3:1631822003:1.source_cn: 我承认之前说想变成其他动物的声音太大了一点。
say:3:1631822003:1.male: And yeah... maybe I made too much noise earlier about wanting to try transfiguration.
say:3:1631822003:1.female: And yeah... maybe I made too much noise earlier about wanting to try transfiguration.

choice_prompt:4:1631822003.text: And yeah... maybe I made too much noise earlier about wanting to try transfiguration.
choice_prompt:4:1631822003.source_cn: 我承认之前说想变成其他动物的声音太大了一点。
choice_prompt:4:1631822003.male: And yeah... maybe I made too much noise earlier about wanting to try transfiguration.
choice_prompt:4:1631822003.female: And yeah... maybe I made too much noise earlier about wanting to try transfiguration.

say:5:1631822004:1.text: A dirty dog, a lazy cat... all heavy, clumsy creatures. It's no fun being in their skin.
say:5:1631822004:1.source_cn: 脏兮兮的狗，懒洋洋的猫，都太过笨重。
say:5:1631822004:1.male: A dirty dog, a lazy cat... all heavy, clumsy creatures. It's no fun being in their skin.
say:5:1631822004:1.female: A dirty dog, a lazy cat... all heavy, clumsy creatures. It's no fun being in their skin.

say:6:1631822005:1.text: And when I ran into humans I didn't like, all I could do was run on four legs. I missed my wings so much.
say:6:1631822005:1.source_cn: 面对不喜欢的人类，只能靠四条腿跑，我太想念我的翅膀了。
say:6:1631822005:1.male: And when I ran into humans I didn't like, all I could do was run on four legs. I missed my wings so much.
say:6:1631822005:1.female: And when I ran into humans I didn't like, all I could do was run on four legs. I missed my wings so much.

say:7:1631822007:1.text: Ugh! I was born for the sky. That's where I truly belong!
say:7:1631822007:1.source_cn: 啊！我果然一生都属于自由的天空！
say:7:1631822007:1.male: Ugh! I was born for the sky. That's where I truly belong!
say:7:1631822007:1.female: Ugh! I was born for the sky. That's where I truly belong!

say:9:1631822006:1.text: I did. Hepler turned me into a stupid frog!
say:9:1631822006:1.source_cn: 试过，赫普把我变成了一只该死的青蛙！
say:9:1631822006:1.male: I did. Hepler turned me into a stupid frog!
say:9:1631822006:1.female: I did. Hepler turned me into a stupid frog!

choice:4:1:2.text: You didn't try something that swims?
choice:4:1:2.male: You didn't try something that swims?
choice:4:1:2.female: You didn't try something that swims?
